ai_summary: Ceigall India Limited has secured significant new Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) road contracts from the Ministry of Road Transport & Highways, totaling ₹2,149.62 crore for projects in Arunachal Pradesh, executed through a 74% joint venture. This materially strengthens the company's order book and reinforces its strategic presence in critical infrastructure development across challenging geographies; successful execution of these large, long-term projects will be key to realizing their full value.
